mission.objective: Add a bounded CLI flag with test coverage
mission.title: Add --json to status command
mission.task: Add a `--json` flag to the existing `status` subcommand in src/cli/statusCommand.ts that prints the same fields as machine-readable JSON instead of the table. Add unit tests covering the flag in the same file's test suite. The output shape is already specified by the existing table columns, so no new fields are needed.
